channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Weekly Round-Up: 13 Matches Played, Big Wins & Cup Drama
item.description: A busy week of 13 matches featuring strong away wins, hard-earned draws, and dramatic cup ties—now it’s on to 14 fixtures next week across Meath League, Dublin League, and the Meath Cup.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Round-Up: 5 Matches Played, 13 More to Come
item.description: A busy week of league and cup action: two league draws, a big cup win for Grade 7 Mixed, and a tough away loss for Grade 2 Men’s. Next week ramps up with 13 matches across league and cup.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
